name: grow-eco-system
description: GROW — Integrated Creative & Enterprise Infrastructure Operating as One. A unified monorepo: the GROW hub (marketing site + admin OS), Grow Engine (growth-intelligence platform), Growees Producer (recruitment engine), and shared brand + engine packages.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm-run-all --parallel build:hub build:engine build:producer && npm run build:worker
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@growengine/db && npm run build --workspace=@growengine/core
scripts.db:hub: npm run db:push --workspace=grow && npm run seed --workspace=grow
scripts.db:engine: npm run migrate --workspace=@growengine/db && npm run seed --workspace=@growengine/db
scripts.db:producer: npm run db:push --workspace=the-growees-producer && npm run db:seed:demo --workspace=the-growees-producer
